title: Approval Center: a bulk run that ends after leaving the page leaves a sticky toast whose "Show all" opens nothing
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Filing gate ① — a user-visible defect with a named location. Source: fleet (nit from the seat's L1 of PR #37282, hand-off 7165958218; listed by the seat for filing). Follow-up of #36855, merged in PR #37282.

Grading: `area:ux` · Bug · p3 (a dead button on a leftover toast; nothing is lost) · reach: read from code · evidence: read.

## What happens

`ApprovalsInboxPage` dismisses the sticky partial-failure toasts it has raised when the page unmounts (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx:1118–1124`). A bulk approve or reject that is still running when the user leaves the page finishes afterwards and raises its sticky toast then. That toast was never registered for dismissal, and its "Show all (M)" action calls the unmounted page's `setBulkFailures` / `setBulkFailuresOpen` (`:1551–1552`), so the toast stays on screen and its button opens nothing.

## Expected

A run that finishes after the page has unmounted either raises no sticky toast, or raises one whose action still shows that run's failed rows (for example, by navigating back to the Approval Center with the list).

## Done when

- A pin starts a bulk run, unmounts the page before the run settles, and asserts the chosen behaviour, with a control on a run that settles while mounted.
- An ablation of the fix turns the pin red.

## Why

A decider who starts a large bulk approve and moves on gets a toast saying rows failed, with a button that does nothing, and no way to see which rows or why.

Reader: the `area:ux` zone (a4-C) dispatches it to an os-dev. Dedupe: `bulk approve toast` → 70 hits, 0 open on this mechanism; `toast show all unmount` → 9 hits, 0 open.
